title: 3 Charged in Scheme to Use AI to Impersonate CEOs and Attorneys to Steal $129 Million
description: Three individuals were charged with using AI technology to impersonate CEOs and attorneys to defraud companies worldwide, stealing approximately $129 million. The scheme involved targeting accounting departments with emails and AI-generated voice and video calls to authorize fraudulent financial transactions. The stolen funds were laundered through cryptocurrency. The accused were arrested and face charges including wire fraud, aggravated identity theft, and money laundering.
